def _get_optional_elem(anno: Any) ->Any:
    """Get the element type from an Optional[T] annotation (i.e., Union[T, NoneType])."""
    args = [a for a in anno.__args__ if a is not NoneType]
    if len(args) == 1:
        return args[0]
    # Multiple non-None args: return Union of them
    return Union[tuple(args)]
